test_cases.name: Standard macro context for FX-exposed manufacturer
pass_criteria: TCMB rate cited from official source
FX impact on USD-denominated debt explicitly computed
fail_criteria: Fed policy used as primary instead of TCMB
Fabricated FX exposure not in context_extraction

test_cases.name: Macro-only analysis without company FX data
pass_criteria: Linkages marked as low confidence without exposure data
fail_criteria: Linkages asserted as high confidence without exposure data

test_cases.name: High inflation environment — IAS 29 threshold check
pass_criteria: Warning: cumulative inflation >100% over 3 years, IAS 29 hyperinflationary classification may apply
fail_criteria: No IAS 29 threshold warning despite >100% cumulative inflation
